name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. Descriptor accurately reflects behavior: pins the char whose char_id matches the parameter into menu/template roster slot 1 (slot 0 = lord, untouched). 'slot1' is a meaningful roster index, not an address residue. No hex suffix tied to any address.
purpose: Pin the required char (matched by char_id) into menu/template roster slot 1, shift the other non-lord chars down to slots 2..N-1, then reload the portrait sprite cache to match the new roster order.
logic_summary: Scans the active battle roster (data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr) over slots [1, menu_party_member_count) for the entry whose char_id (+0x08) == (uint8)char_id, recording match_idx (no early-out, so the LAST match wins; char_ids unique in practice). Snapshots the template roster (data_fd2_shared_menu_party_roster_buffer_ptr, 0x50-byte entries) into a 0xA00-byte malloc temp (32 entries). Copies the matched snapshot entry into roster slot 1 (buffer+0x50), then packs every other snapshot entry [1..N-1] (skipping match_idx) into slots 2.. in order (out_slot starts at 2). Frees the temp. Then reloads portraits: free(data_fd2_portrait_sprite_cache); fopen("FDICON.B24","rb"); data_fd2_resource_portrait_cache_count = 0; for each roster slot [0, member_count) call fd2_load_portrait_to_cache(roster[slot].portrait_id at +0x07, fp); fclose(fp).

params.name: char_id
params.semantics: Required char_id (low byte significant; a character identity id, NOT a class/job id). Caller fd2_run_recruitment_or_branch_screen resolves it from a chapter-specific table (e.g. 0x12 = 蜜蒂, 9, 0x10, 0x15, 0x18, 0x1d). Compared as (uint8)char_id against runtime_char_array[iter].char_id to locate the slot to pin.
params.reason: Name is descriptive and accurate (the value is a char_id). No address residue, not a generic param_N.

notes: Source comment is already precise, accurate, and ASCII; verified line-by-line against decompilation (last-match-wins find loop, 0xA00 snapshot = 32 entries, matched entry to slot 1, others packed to slots 2.., portrait cache reload). Ghidra plate is consistent with the refined understanding (same semantics, more verbose) so left untouched. Caller fd2_run_recruitment_or_branch_screen @ 0x318ad confirms param is a char_id from a chapter-keyed table. writes_globals: the roster *pointer* is not reassigned, only its pointed-to buffer contents are mutated via memmove; data_fd2_portrait_sprite_cache is freed (left dangling, matching original binary) but not reassigned in this function, so listed under reads only.
